subject.title: feat(session): add named new and close chat commands

question: Should native/chat `/new` treat non-model text as a session name, and should `/close`/`/delete` become cross-channel chat commands now?
rationale: Those choices change user-visible command grammar and expose destructive session cleanup from chat; automation can identify the compatibility risk but cannot choose the permanent product contract.

options.title: Preserve fallthrough, require explicit names
options.body: Keep `/new <free text>` as prompt fallthrough on native and text surfaces, and allow naming only through explicit `--name` or `name:` syntax unless a separate native title contract is approved.

options.title: Approve native title semantics
options.body: Accept that native `/new` text is a title field, update docs/proof accordingly, and treat the prompt fallthrough loss as an intentional compatibility break.

options.title: Defer destructive chat cleanup
options.body: Land only the safe naming pieces or pause this PR until the broader session title/delete PRs settle.

recommendation.title: Preserve fallthrough, require explicit names
recommendation.body: Keep `/new <free text>` as prompt fallthrough on native and text surfaces, and allow naming only through explicit `--name` or `name:` syntax unless a separate native title contract is approved.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work covers session deletion permissions and new-chat product behavior, making this the best available routing signal for the product choice.
